Hi Maria / Sofia — operational runbook excerpt below (we'll attach the fuller ops playbook on the call):

1) Failover trigger: region outage > 5 minutes + packet loss/latency thresholds + capacity exhausted in Eu-central.
2) Scope: only active inference traffic from affected tenant; cache warmup and KV synchronization may require short-lived replication to a pre-approved failover region.
3) Max window: 48 hours from trigger; any extension requires manual approval from Redwood SRE + notification to PulseMed security contact.
4) Audit & telemetry: every cross-region operation is logged with start/stop timestamps, request ids, and node identifiers. Logs + token-level traces are provided to customers upon request under NDA.
5) Data minimization: we redact/strip any telemetry fields not required for routing/availability; we do not retain request payloads beyond the retention agreed in the DPA annex.
6) Subprocessor note: CDN/edge providers may cache non-PII assets; we will certify in the roster which subs are used for each function.

I'll attach subprocessor_roster_20260914.csv and the SOC 2 link in the follow-up to Maria. Happy to join the handshake call and walk the team through the live audit artifact flow.

— Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
